item.title: About
item.description:
About Me

I am currently a research fellow at the University of Melbourne within the Mathematics and Statistics department and MACSYS. My current research deals with multiscale modelling methods and machine learning techniques in mathematical biology.

I also work on compute verification for AI governance, as a MATS research fellow.

Prior to that I was a research fellow in gravitational wave astrophysics within the Physics department as part of OzGrav

Prior to that I was a postdoc at the University of Oxford where I researched reduced precision arithmetic and machine learning techniques applied to climate simulations.
